sections.title: Impersonal Modal 'Lehet, hogy...'
sections.content: To express that an event is possible, Hungarian commonly uses *Lehet, hogy...* ('It is possible that...') followed by a clause in the indicative or conditional. Unlike English 'might/may', Hungarian handles this epistemic modality through the impersonal verb *lehet* or *megtörténhet, hogy...*.

items.spanish: Lehet, hogy holnap megváltozik az időjárás, és kisüt a nap.
items.english: It is possible that the weather will change tomorrow and the sun will shine.

items.spanish: Megtörténhet, hogy a vonat késéssel érkezik a pályaudvarra.
items.english: It can happen that the train arrives at the station with a delay.
